title: Version 17.14.40
body_markdown:
*Released September 8th, 2026*

| Top bug fixes | From the community |
| --- | --- |
| Visual Studio now requires consent before opening debugger dump or memory snapshot files from UNC paths that fall outside a trusted folder, including sibling paths that only share the trusted folder's text prefix. |  |

| Security advisories addressed | CVE | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| SQLite Information Disclosure Vulnerability | [CVE-2025-70873](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2025-70873) | An information disclosure vulnerability exists in SQLite's zipfileInflate function when processing a specially crafted archive. |
| OpenSSL Vulnerability | [CVE-2026-34182](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-34182) | This security update updates OpenSSL to address CVE-2026-34182. |
| .NET Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability | [CVE-2026-69805](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-69805) | Microsoft.Diagnostics.Runtime accepts dump-controlled remote paths, which can disclose NTLMv2 credentials or load attacker-controlled native code. |
| .NET and Visual Studio Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability | [CVE-2026-69439](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-69439) | A 64-bit-to-32-bit truncation in Microsoft.DiaSymReader.Native can cause an out-of-bounds write when parsing a crafted Portable PDB. |
| .NET and Visual Studio Remote Code Execution Vulnerability | [CVE-2026-69522](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-69522) | An oversized memcpy in Microsoft.DiaSymReader.Native can write out of bounds when processing a specially crafted PDB. |
| ASP.NET Core Denial of Service Vulnerability | [CVE-2026-69304](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-69304) | IIS out-of-process hosting can allow RequestDecompressionMiddleware to process an unbounded decompressed body, resulting in a denial of service. |
| .NET Information Disclosure Vulnerability | [CVE-2026-58649](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-58649) | Insufficient cross-origin WebSocket validation in dotnet watch can expose IL and PDB information. |
| .NET Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability | [CVE-2026-69806](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-69806) | dotnet watch exposes information through procfs arguments that can enable injection into the `/run_session` endpoint. |
| .NET and Visual Studio Remote Code Execution Vulnerability | [CVE-2026-71328](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-71328) | An integer wrap in Microsoft.DiaSymReader.Native can cause a heap out-of-bounds write when processing a crafted MSFZ PDB. |
body_html:
Released September 8th, 2026

Top bug fixes From the community
Visual Studio now requires consent before opening debugger dump or memory snapshot files from UNC paths that fall outside a trusted folder, including sibling paths that only share the trusted folder's text prefix.
Security advisories addressed CVE Description
SQLite Information Disclosure Vulnerability CVE-2025-70873 An information disclosure vulnerability exists in SQLite's zipfileInflate function when processing a specially crafted archive.
OpenSSL Vulnerability CVE-2026-34182 This security update updates OpenSSL to address CVE-2026-34182.
.NET Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability CVE-2026-69805 Microsoft.Diagnostics.Runtime accepts dump-controlled remote paths, which can disclose NTLMv2 credentials or load attacker-controlled native code.
.NET and Visual Studio Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability CVE-2026-69439 A 64-bit-to-32-bit truncation in Microsoft.DiaSymReader.Native can cause an out-of-bounds write when parsing a crafted Portable PDB.
.NET and Visual Studio Remote Code Execution Vulnerability CVE-2026-69522 An oversized memcpy in Microsoft.DiaSymReader.Native can write out of bounds when processing a specially crafted PDB.
ASP.NET Core Denial of Service Vulnerability CVE-2026-69304 IIS out-of-process hosting can allow RequestDecompressionMiddleware to process an unbounded decompressed body, resulting in a denial of service.
.NET Information Disclosure Vulnerability CVE-2026-58649 Insufficient cross-origin WebSocket validation in dotnet watch can expose IL and PDB information.
.NET Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability CVE-2026-69806 dotnet watch exposes information through procfs arguments that can enable injection into the /run_session endpoint.
.NET and Visual Studio Remote Code Execution Vulnerability CVE-2026-71328 An integer wrap in Microsoft.DiaSymReader.Native can cause a heap out-of-bounds write when processing a crafted MSFZ PDB.
